letpot-mini.why: LetPot lists a 5-pod garden, app control, and a schedulable light.

mizuna-ceramic.why: Two ceramic trays with coir and seeds, listed for a kitchen sill.

letpot-air.why: LetPot lists a 10-pod garden with app-controlled light and water flow.

letpot-lite.why: LetPot lists a 12-pod herb garden with a growing LED and a timer.

letpot-max.why: LetPot lists a 21-pod system with app control and automatic watering.

tl-radish.why: 42 g on a 1020 tray. About 21 g on a 10 by 10.

tl-broccoli.why: Waltham 29 broccoli is in the seed collection. Check the bag.

tl-kits.why: Mini kits are in this collection. Check what the kit includes.
